prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal escalation summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate support-investigation systems. For each escalation in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an agent would post when escalating: why it's being escalated and to whom, based only on the fields given. Do not invent facts beyond what's given. Vary tone/length.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"escalations": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 3465, 'escalation_type': 'technical_escalation', 'trigger_code': 'repeated_failed_attempts', 'from_team': 'TM13', 'to_team': 'TM15', 'severity': 'Sev2', 'suspected_root_cause': 'schema mismatch'}, {'i': 3466, 'escalation_type': 'management_escalation', 'trigger_code': 'customer_pressure', 'from_team': 'TM01', 'to_team': 'TM12', 'severity': 'Sev3', 'suspected_root_cause': 'token expiration handling bug'}, {'i': 3467, 'escalation_type': 'technical_escalation', 'trigger_code': 'customer_pressure', 'from_team': 'TM21', 'to_team': 'TM15', 'severity': 'Sev3', 'suspected_root_cause': 'insufficient capacity planning'}, {'i': 3468, 'escalation_type': 'management_escalation', 'trigger_code': 'customer_pressure', 'from_team': 'TM01', 'to_team': 'TM07', 'severity': 'Sev4', 'suspected_root_cause': 'token expiration handling bug'}]
